title: LA City General Fund postings, March 2026 vs March 2025

attempts.text: In March 2026, the General Fund postings decreased by 0.9% compared to March 2025, marking a reduction of $9.9 million. This decrease is primarily attributed to the General Services category, which saw a decrease of $4.4 million, and the Non-Departmental - Water and Electricity category, which also decreased by $4.2 million. These changes reflect a reduction in expenditures, likely due to budget adjustments or decreased demand for services.

In March 2026, the General Fund postings decreased by 0.9% compared to the same month in 2025, totaling $1,058.7 million. This represents a decrease of $9.9 million from the year-over-year comparison. The largest movers in the General Services category saw a decrease of $4.4 million, while the Non-Departmental - Water and Electricity category experienced a decrease of $4.2 million. The Non-Departmental - Petroleum Products category showed an increase of $4.1 million, and the City Attorney's postings increased by $2.9 million. The Non-Departmental - Capital Improvement Expense Program category also saw an increase of $2.7 million.
